mapper.select: select id from documents where id=#{documentId} and deleted='0' and approval_status='IN_REVIEW' for update
mapper.sql: from sys_user u join sys_user_role ur on ur.user_id=u.user_id join sys_role r on r.role_id=ur.role_id where u.user_id=#{userId} and u.status='0' and u.del_flag='0' and r.status='0' and r.del_flag='0'
mapper.select: select count(*) and exists(select 1 from sys_role_menu rm join sys_menu m on m.menu_id=rm.menu_id where rm.role_id=r.role_id and m.status='0' and m.perms=#{permission})

select count(*) from documents d join sys_user owner on owner.user_id=d.creator_id join sys_user u on u.user_id=#{userId} where d.id=#{documentId} and d.deleted='0' and u.status='0' and u.del_flag='0' and (u.rank_level='EXEC' or (u.rank_level='LEADER' and u.dept_id=owner.dept_id) or u.user_id=d.creator_id)

select count(*) from documents d where d.id=#{documentId} and (d.creator_id=#{userId} or exists ( select 1 from document_versions v where v.document_id=d.id and v.version_no=d.current_version and (v.submitted_by=#{userId} or exists ( select 1 from workflow_instances i join workflow_tasks t on t.instance_id=i.id where i.version_id=v.id and t.status='COMPLETED' and t.acted_by=#{userId}))))
